3.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that opposite party no.2 is the daughter-in-law of the applicant and is misusing her clout and regularly threatening the applicant, as such, the anticipatory bail granted to opposite party no.2 may be cancelled.

5. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 has opposed the anticipatory bail cancellation application on the ground that there is no valid ground to cancel the anticipatory bail granted to opposite party no.2 as there is no FIR or allegation of the applicant tampering with evidence whatsoever.
The opposite party no.2 is cooperating in trial.

6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the fact that counsel for the applicant could not bring forward any valid ground to cancel the anticipatory bail granted to opposite party no.2 vide order dated 22.4.2024, I do not find it to be a fit case to cancel the anticipatory bail granted to opposite party no.2.
7.
The instant anticipatory bail cancellation application being misconceived and without any basis stands dismissed.

Order Date :- 7.8.2025 Vikas (Justice Krishan Pahal)
